title: Signature Title Ritual
description: A Signature-original deck-building ritual authored in the Signature system: every deck opens with a title slide that states the single promise of the talk in ten words or fewer, stamps the deck's color story, and sets the type scale for everything after. The ritual requires writing the title slide last — only after the argument is finished — so the promise matches what the deck actually proves. This is a Signature method, an original work, not a public record.
demo:
promise = 'Every deck proves one promise'
print('words:', len(promise.split()), '(<= 10 ok)')
print('ritual: write the title slide LAST, after the argument is done')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: JAH 7-Beat Deck Method
description: A Signature-original structure: seven beats — Hook, Problem, Turn, Proof, Cost, Vision, Ask — each beat owning a fixed number of slides so a 21-slide talk can be timed to the minute. The Turn is the Signature beat: the single slide where the audience's assumption flips. Labeled Signature; an original composition, not a public standard.
demo:
beats = [('Hook',2),('Problem',3),('Turn',1),('Proof',6),('Cost',2),('Vision',4),('Ask',3)]
print('total slides:', sum(n for _, n in beats))
for name, n in beats:
    print(f'  {name}: {n} slides')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Color Discipline
description: A Signature-original discipline: one ink color, one paper color, one signal color per deck — three colors total, chosen on the master and never overridden on individual slides. The signal color is spent only on the single most important element per slide. Signature-original, clearly labeled, not a public standard.
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Notes Doctrine
description: A Signature-original doctrine for presenter notes: notes are written as spoken sentences, timed at 130 words per minute, with a [BEAT] cue wherever the speaker must pause and a [CLICK] cue wherever the slide must advance. The doctrine forbids reading bullet text aloud — the slide shows the skeleton, the notes carry the voice. Signature-original, labeled as such.
demo:
wpm = 130
notes_words = 260
print('2 slides of notes ~', round(notes_words/wpm, 1), 'minutes of speech')
print('cues: [BEAT] pause, [CLICK] advance — never read bullets aloud')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Handout Protocol
description: A Signature-original handout protocol: every deck ships a three-per-page handout with ruled lines, printed to PDF and proofed separately, carrying the deck's promise on the header of page one. The protocol treats the handout as the artifact the audience keeps — so contact, date, and the single ask appear in its footer. Signature-original.

print('handout: 3/page + ruled lines -> PDF -> proof separately')
print('footer carries: promise, date, the single ask')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Kiosk Loop
description: A Signature-original method for self-running decks: 10-second beats, type at 48 points or larger, one idea per slide, and the loop engineered so the last slide hands off invisibly to the first. The method includes a 'loop audit' — watching three full cycles to catch any slide that lingers or flashes. Signature-original.
demo:
beats = 8
print('loop:', beats, 'slides x 10s =', beats*10, 's per cycle')
print('audit: watch 3 full cycles before shipping the loop')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Chart Honesty Rule
description: A Signature-original rule for data slides: every chart carries its takeaway as the headline, its source as a footnote, and its axis starting honestly — truncated axes must be flagged in the headline itself. The rule bans 3-D effects and decoration that encodes nothing. Signature-original, labeled Signature.
demo:
print('headline = conclusion, footnote = source')
print('truncated axis? flag it in the headline, never hide it')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Diagram Grammar
description: A Signature-original grammar for diagrams: one entry point, numbered reading order, arrows that mean one thing (flow, never decoration), and a legend whenever a shape carries meaning. Any diagram that needs more than a breath of explanation is split into two slides. Signature-original.
demo:
print('grammar: 1 entry point, numbered order, arrows = flow only')
print('rule: if it needs explaining, split it into two slides')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Transition Budget
description: A Signature-original budget: one transition style per deck at half a second, animations only for progressive disclosure, zero auto-advance unless the loop is the product. Every animation is rehearsed twice; anything unrehearsed is deleted the night before. Signature-original.

print('budget: 1 transition style, 0.5s, disclosure-only animation')
print('rule: unrehearsed animation = deleted animation')

title: Signature Master Inheritance Drill
description: A Signature-original drill: build the master first with fonts, colors, and footers; derive every layout from it; then forbid hand-formatting on slides for the rest of the build. The drill ends with a rebrand test — change the master accent color and confirm the whole deck follows in one edit. Signature-original.

title: Signature 4:3 Retrofit
description: A Signature-original retrofit procedure for legacy 4:3 venues: duplicate the 16:9 deck, re-flow (never stretch) text blocks, re-anchor full-bleed images to center, and re-proof every slide at the venue's projector resolution before showtime. Signature-original.

title: Signature 16:9 Grid
description: A Signature-original layout grid for 16:9 slides: a 12-column grid with half-inch margins, title band in the top sixth, and body content never crossing the optical center line. The grid keeps multi-slide sequences feeling like one continuous document. Signature-original.

title: Signature Pitch Spine

title: Signature Lecture Arc
description: A Signature-original lecture arc: Ignite (one surprising fact), Build (concept plus worked example), Test (audience check question), Land (three takeaways). The arc repeats per 15-minute block and the Land slide of each block becomes the study guide. Signature-original.

title: Signature Deck Audit
description: A Signature-original pre-flight audit run the night before delivery: count words per slide (flag any over 40), check every chart for source and honest axes, confirm the master governs all formatting, time the full run twice, and export the handout PDF. A deck that fails any check does not ship. Signature-original.
